description: This Java source file defines the class RSSPullParser, which extends DefaultHandler and is responsible for parsing RSS feed XML data using the XMLPull API. It extracts image URLs and thumbnails from the RSS, storing them in a vector of ContentValues for later use. The class includes methods to parse XML input streams, handle XML parsing events, and manage internal data structures. It is part of an Android project and appears to be specific to parsing RSS feeds from Picasa's featured pictures.

classes.name: RSSPullParser
classes.description: A class that parses RSS XML feeds to extract image and thumbnail URLs, storing them in a vector of ContentValues. It uses the XMLPull API and is tailored for Android environments.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Returns the vector containing all of the image data retrieved by the parser.

methods.name: parseXml
methods.description: Parses an InputStream containing RSS feed XML data, extracting image URLs and thumbnails, populating the internal vector and notifying progress via a helper class.
